jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Job title: AI Solution Developer Location: Hyderabad Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com. About the job: The AI Solution Developer builds, integrates, and operates AI agents that act directly within Opella’s Manufacturing & Supply (M&S) core systems — Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Quality Management Systems (QMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP). Where analytics and copilots advise, this role makes agents act: designing, deploying, and running production-grade agentic workflows that execute tasks, trigger transactions, and close the loop between insight and operation across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality. This is a hands-on, technical-and-business hybrid role at the heart of the MS.AI Factory. The ideal candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with deep familiarity of manufacturing and supply chain systems, and thrives in a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) model — embedded with business teams, shipping working agents into live operations rather than slideware. Main Responsibilities Agent Development: Design, build, and integrate AI agents that act within MES, QMS, and ERP — so agents execute tasks and transactions, not just generate recommendations. System Integration: Connect agents to enterprise systems (SAP, MES, QMS, LIMS) through APIs, MCP-based integrations, and event-driven workflows, ensuring safe, auditable, and reversible actions. End-to-End Delivery: Own the full lifecycle from proof-of-concept to production and operations — experimentation → productionization → monitoring and maintenance. Agentic AI & GenAI: Build RAG workflows, multi-agent orchestrations, and LLM-powered solutions using modern agentic frameworks, vector databases, embeddings, and prompt engineering. Forward Deployed Engineering: Embed with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality stakeholders to identify high-value use cases and ship working agents directly into their workflows. Reliability & Guardrails: Establish data hygiene, validation, human-in-the-loop controls, and observability so autonomous actions are safe, GxP-aware, compliant, and trustworthy. Operate & Scale: Run deployed agents in production, monitor performance, cost, and drift, and continuously improve reliability and measurable business impact. Enablement: Partner with Citizen Developers and AI Champions, turning proven agents into reusable, scalable patterns across the M&S organization. About you: Required Skills & Qualifications Software & AI Engineering: Strong hands-on development skills (Python), with production-ready software engineering practices — OOP, coding standards, version control, testing, and CI/CD. Agentic AI & GenAI: Experience designing and deploying LLM-powered and agentic solutions (RAG, autonomous and multi-agent systems), with MCP-based integrations, embeddings, vector databases, and prompt engineering. System Integration: Proven ability to integrate solutions directly into enterprise systems via APIs; exposure to MES / QMS / ERP (SAP) and manufacturing / supply chain data. MLOps / AgentOps: Experience operationalizing models and agents — automated build / test / deploy, monitoring, and observability (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow or similar; GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Cloud & Data: Comfortable in cloud and high-performance environments (Azure, AWS, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) and building data pipelines. Business Understanding: Familiarity with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality processes and KPIs, and the ability to translate business problems into deployable agents. Experience: [Add required years] of hands-on experience building and deploying production AI / software solutions; life-sciences or regulated (GxP) manufacturing experience is a strong plus. Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline. Soft & Behavioral Skills Challenger Mindset: Demonstrates a proactive and questioning mindset, constantly challenging the status quo and driving innovation in AI use cases. All In, Together: Strong collaboration across global, cross-functional teams, acting as a bridge between business and technical stakeholders in an FDE setup. Outcome-Obsessed: Focuses relentlessly on delivering measurable business impact, prioritizing high-value outcomes in Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Quality. Courageous: Takes ownership, makes decisions in complex environments, and drives initiatives forward end-to-end, even under uncertainty. Radically Simple: Ability to simplify complex systems, processes, and AI solutions into clear, actionable, and scalable products. Ownership & Accountability: Takes full ownership of delivery — not only design, but hands-on implementation and successful deployment into operations. Communication: Clear and structured communication adapted to both business and technical audiences. Why us? At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. We Are Challengers. We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. Outcome-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be. Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www.opella.com/en/careers

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company hiring its founding India team

Location:
Remote (India)
About the Company

A venture-backed SaaS company is building out its founding India engineering team and has partnered with Flexiple to hire an early Machine Learning Engineer. You will be one of the first ML hires shaping how the product uses models from the ground up, with direct input into what gets built next. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.
Role Overview

As a founding Machine Learning Engineer, you will move fast from prototype to shipped feature, owning models end-to-end in a small, high-ownership team with minimal process overhead.
Key Responsibilities

Rapid Model Shipping

Prototype and ship ML-powered features directly into the product, often within days rather than sprints
Fine-tune and evaluate LLMs or smaller models for the company's specific use case
Make pragmatic build-vs-buy calls between in-house models and third-party APIs

Ownership & Scale

Set up lightweight but solid infrastructure for training, evaluation, and deployment as the product scales
Instrument usage and model performance to guide the next iteration
Work directly with the founders and product team to prioritise what ML should solve next

Ideal Candidate Profile

2 to 6 years in applied machine learning, with at least one product shipped to real users
Comfortable working with ambiguity, thin specs, and fast-changing priorities
Strong Python skills and familiarity with modern LLM and ML tooling
Clear written and spoken English and a reliable remote-work setup

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, or prompt-based systems in production
Prior experience at an early-stage startup or as a founding engineer
A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field

What We Offer

A founding ML seat with outsized ownership on a fast-moving SaaS product
Remote-friendly, pan-India hiring with long-term placement
Direct, daily collaboration with founders and early product decisions
One application considered for this and future matched roles

Hiring Process

HR Screening → Take-Home Build → Founder Round → Culture Fit
